title: The Cold Ghost
author: Gideon Nakamura
blurb: Odile Ashgrove, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
